subsystem: Telegram bot core (long-polling client and update dispatcher)
purpose: A dependency-free Bot API client `tg()` with a 15 s timeout and one retry on 429 (waits up to 30 s). A getMe backoff at startup, then a single in-process getUpdates loop. `handleUpdate` routes to handlers for contact, /start, /myid, admin reply, support and callback_query.
dependencies: env TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID; Prisma User.telegramChatId, phone and isPhoneVerified; server.ts bootstrap (startTelegramBot/stopTelegramBot); railway.json numReplicas 1.
risks: Availability flag set once and never cleared; one sequential loop, so a 429 sleep stalls every flow; offset kept in memory; no chat.type check; identity keyed by chat.id; no per-chat throttling.
ownership: Backend API: apps/api/src/modules/telegram/telegram.service.ts. No explicit owner declared.

subsystem: Telegram account linking and phone verification

GET /api/telegram/status; DELETE /api/telegram/link. `requirePhoneVerified` gates apply, vacancy create, conversation start and reviews. Web side: TelegramConnect, PersonalInfo, AccountSettings, PhoneGateNotice.
dependencies: telegram.routes.ts, telegram.service.ts, auth-guard.ts, profile.routes.ts, schema User (phone not unique), web lib/api.ts (fetchTelegramStatus, requestTelegramLink).
risks: No confirmation or account binding (link CSRF); silent re-linking; no phone uniqueness; silent phone overwrite; no audit or notification; no unlink UI; hard dependency on a bot documented as optional.
ownership: Backend API (telegram, profile, auth-guard) plus web profile components.
